component_design_specs.cards: Border-driven 1px solid border (border-border/60) with subtle dark slate background (bg-card), sharp/minimal radius (rounded-lg), no heavy drop shadows

status_badges.active: bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full
status_badges.high_risk: bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20 font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full

component_design_specs.tables: Dense administrative layout, sticky headers, subtle row hover state (hover:bg-muted/40), pagination, sorting, status filters, selection checkboxes
component_design_specs.charts: Recharts responsive containers using semi-transparent gradients under line curves, dark tooltip cards, precise custom color palettes
component_design_specs.rich_email_editor: Interactive simulation composer with variable tags, template gallery, live device toggle preview (Desktop / Mobile)
component_design_specs.forms: Structured step-by-step wizard for simulation creation: 1. Target Audience, 2. Sender Identity, 3. Email Template & Trigger, 4. Landing/Awareness Page, 5. Schedule & Launch

image_urls.description: Security Operation Center with monitors displaying data streams

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, navigation links, filters, table rows, tab switches, modal triggers, and key metric numbers MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure dark theme looks like a crisp SOC enterprise console with subtle 1px border lines, dark indigo/cyan accents, and high-visibility status tags.
Do NOT use forbidden teal color #1B93A4 or forbidden font Space Grotesk.
Make sure every view has realistic sample data (e.g. realistic phishing templates like Executive HR Salary Review, IT Password Reset, Urgent Cloud Storage Access, Office 365 Re-authentication).
Provide interactive features in Sandbox/Test mode so authorized admins can simulate live clicks, opens, and form entries to test analytics updates in real-time.
Use Lucide-react or Radix UI icons consistently.
Always attach data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
